}}'''Miri''' was a ''[[damane]]''.{{ref/book|twotc|Miri}}

== History ==
She was [[Falendre|Falendre's]] ''damane'' and served in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].

== Activities ==
She died in the meeting between the [[Dragon Reborn]] and the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] when it was revealed that the latter was actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise.

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Miri}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Valerie Vachkova}}.
